headline: Fronts Shift as Casualties Surge Across Six Sectors
war_summary: On day 362 the conflict remains divided between Colonial‑held western regions and Warden‑held northern sectors, but the last three hours have intensified the churn on a half‑dozen fronts. Weathered Expanse now records 34 ownership changes in 24 hours — up from 32 in the previous edition — with Colonial casualties at 184,183 and Warden casualties at 202,163; both casualty rates and enlistments are accelerating. Mooring County has surged to 32 flips, seven in the past two hours, pushing its 24‑hour toll to 27,135 Colonial and 22,838 Warden dead while enlistments climb sharply. Stonecradle remains a flashpoint with 17 flips centred on World’s End, The Reach and Buckler Sound, totals 61,526 Colonial and 78,585 Warden. Stlican Shelf adds ten flips near Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, 58,934 Colonial and 66,117 Warden. Farranac Coast holds at seven flips, losses 49,088 Colonial and 61,151 Warden. Linn Mercy eases to four flips around Lathair, 54,768 Colonial and 69,165 Warden. Fishermans Row shows only three flips in the last day, down from earlier reports. Northern Warden‑held sectors and rear areas continue to show no ownership changes.
